item.description:

My first blog

This is not my first blog. I had a blog back in 2004 (under a different domain).
I used Wordpress which at the time was quite revolutionary by providing a nice interface to edit my posts. But the downside was that it was a complex framework that you had to keep up to date every so often.

I don't remember how difficult it was but needless to say I did not go and installed every update. One day in 2006 my blog was hacked and all my posts replaced.

I had a backup of the database so the post weren't completely lost. But restoring them was too big of a hassle for me at the time.

That was the end of my blog.

This time it's simpler

I have been using Emacs for some time and like the idea that everything is stored in text files.
Text files are timeless.

It became clear to me that my future blog needs to be based on text files and an easy way to create html files from them.
Meet org-static-blog an Emacs package to create static html files from org documents.

I'll might write more about my workflow.
For now I'm happy I was able to revive my blog.
